main_text.p: פנם Ch.Frangi, fractum,ruptu, incisum esse, Part.
עד דפגמא סיהרא Dum luna incisa fit, Jobi 25.5.
פוגני Ch. Videtur significare, Paganus, Esth. 4.1. in Targ.sec. Sed locus apparet esse corruptus, & vox haec cum sequentibus duabus superflua.
ܦܓܢ Syr. Ruta, Ex Graeco πήγανον, Lucae 11.42. Apud Talmudicos vocatur similiter פגן & פגם.
פגע Ch. & Syr. Occurrere, obviam fieri, venire.
Aphel אפגיע Incurrere facere: Item Intervenire, intercedere. Unde Futur. ולא תפגיעי על יהוראי Et non intercesseris pro Judaeis, Esth.4.14.
פגעין Ch. Daemones, spiritus maligni, Esth.1.2. in T. secundo.
פגר Pahel Ch. Demoliri, destruere, diruere, vastare. Ithpah. אתפגר Destrui, dirui.

פגרא, פגר Ch.& Syr.Destructio: Corpus,corpus destructum, cadaver proprie, ut & Hebr. Syriace autem promiscue de corpore integro & destructo usurpatur: Ex quo usu etiam de corpore integro legitur in Targ. Prov.10.15. Plur. פגרי, פגרין.
מפגרות Ch.Idem. Nomen ex Infinitivo factum.
ܦܓܪܢܐ Syr. Corporeus, corporalis, carnalis. Plural

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic (Syriac) and Greek words are reproduced as far as legible; some vowel points and the Syriac headword forms are uncertain. The catchword "ral" at the foot is the signature-continued word "Plural" split at the line end.
